verdict.rationale: A national company registry could plausibly offer a documented public API, so this axis applies. The evidence pack contains no API documentation or endpoints. The only items are probes recording HTTP 403 at robots.txt on mca.gov.in and nsws.gov.in, which show that nothing beyond robots.txt was fetched. Those blocked fetches show only that the content could not be reached, not that no API exists, so confidence is low.
